items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1960-01-25
items.q: Interviewer mentions Huey and Harry Marone; Interviewee does not confirm personal interaction or relationship with Huey.

ctx.x: Well, that's Trios Lounge. That's a... Remember Huey and Harry Marone had the record shop on Bourbon Street and they put up the money for the thing?
That's when Ken was here. I guess you were here.
